limits: No Production write/deployment or actual student test.
Seven bounded read transactions, not one simultaneous database snapshot.
Direct source case validates actual FK insertion; full legacy capability import/UI path was not replayed.
Temporary synthetic files are not a Production backup.
harnessCorrections: Ambiguous state variable in late probe corrected; first synthetic ready transaction committed but candidate response failed, so a second fake lower key was used for final proof.
An already compacted group was excluded from inline-only preparation; the original external archive was reused.
Direct legacy app case requires an actual dictionary capability package; its FK insertion lock was tested separately while the composition assignment used the real v7 app function.
Synthetic answer timestamps aligned with the existing 100ms feedback contract; rejected batch transaction wrote no answers.

Root contains an existing .git; all-repository archive guard correctly rejected its child folder. Synthetic archives were written outside all Git repositories to a protected temporary folder. No repository was created/removed.
